title: Department store
content: I have lots of different mallworld dreams , but sometimes I go to a department store , sometimes on multiple levels with escalators , last night was just one level. I'm usually looking for something to wear but never find anything , but last night I found the most beautiful green dress, fit perfect. There was makeup to match that came with a free gift, but they had run out of the one I wanted and just had the tester left. Just thought I'd share.
